sanskrit: tām āryagaṇasaṃpūrṇāṃ bharataḥ pragrahāṃ sabhām dadarśa buddhisaṃpannaḥ pūrṇacandrāṃ niśām iva
english: Bharata, endowed with wisdom, beheld that assembly hall filled with noble men and adorned with garlands, like a night illumined by the full moon.

sanskrit: āsanāni yathānyāyam āryāṇāṃ viśatāṃ tadā adṛśyata ghanāpāye pūrṇacandreva śarvarī
english: As the nobles took their seats in proper order, it appeared like a night of the full moon at the close of the rainy season.

sanskrit: rājñas tu prakṛtīḥ sarvāḥ samagrāḥ prekṣya dharmavit idaṃ purohito vākyaṃ bharataṃ mṛdu cābravīt
english: The purohita, knowing dharma, having surveyed all the subjects of the king fully assembled, then spoke these gentle words to Bharata.

sanskrit: tāta rājā daśarathaḥ svargato dharmam ācaran dhana dhānyavatīṃ sphītāṃ pradāya pṛthivīṃ tava
english: "Dear son, King Daśaratha has gone to heaven, having practiced dharma, and having bestowed upon you this prosperous earth, rich in wealth and grain.

sanskrit: rāmas tathā satyadhṛtiḥ satāṃ dharmam anusmaran nājahāt pitur ādeśaṃ śaśī jyotsnām ivoditaḥ
english: Rāma likewise, firm in truth, recalling the dharma of the virtuous, has not abandoned his father's command — just as the risen moon does not abandon its moonlight.

sanskrit: pitrā bhrātrā ca te dattaṃ rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam tad bhuṅkṣva muditāmātyaḥ kṣipram evābhiṣecaya
english: The kingdom, freed of thorns, has been given to you by your father and your brother. Enjoy it with your ministers in gladness; let the consecration be performed at once.

sanskrit: udīcyāś ca pratīcyāś ca dākṣiṇātyāś ca kevalāḥ koṭyāparāntāḥ sāmudrā ratnāny abhiharantu te
english: Let the peoples of the north, the west, the south in their entirety, and of Koṭyāparānta along with the sea-coasts bring their jewels and tributes to you."

sanskrit: tac chrutvā bharato vākyaṃ śokenābhipariplutaḥ jagāma manasā rāmaṃ dharmajño dharmakāṅkṣayā
english: Hearing those words, Bharata, overwhelmed by grief, knowing dharma and longing for righteousness, went to Rāma in his mind.

sanskrit: sa bāṣpakalayā vācā kalahaṃsasvaro yuvā vilalāpa sabhāmadhye jagarhe ca purohitam
english: That young man, his voice like the cry of a swan, choked with tears, lamented in the midst of the assembly and reproached the purohita.

sanskrit: caritabrahmacaryasya vidyā snātasya dhīmataḥ dharme prayatamānasya ko rājyaṃ madvidho haret
english: "Who like me — one who has observed the vow of brahmacarya, who is a bath-graduate of learning, who is wise, who strives steadfastly in dharma — who would seize the kingdom?

sanskrit: kathaṃ daśarathāj jāto bhaved rājyāpahārakaḥ rājyaṃ cāhaṃ ca rāmasya dharmaṃ vaktum ihārhasi
english: How could one born of Daśaratha become a usurper of the kingdom? You ought here to declare that both the kingdom and I belong to Rāma by right.

sanskrit: jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaś ca dharmātmā dilīpanahuṣopamaḥ labdhum arhati kākutstho rājyaṃ daśaratho yathā
english: The eldest, the best, the righteous-souled Kākutstha, comparable to Dilīpa and Nahuṣa, deserves to receive the kingdom, just as Daśaratha did.

sanskrit: anāryajuṣṭam asvargyaṃ kuryāṃ pāpam ahaṃ yadi ikṣvākūṇām ahaṃ loke bhaveyaṃ kulapāṃsanaḥ
english: If I were to commit this sin, fit only for the ignoble and not leading to heaven, I would become the disgrace of the Ikṣvāku lineage in this world.

sanskrit: yad dhi mātrā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nāhaṃ tad abhirocaye ihastho vanadurgasthaṃ namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ
english: Whatever sin has been committed by my mother, I do not approve of it. Standing here, I shall pay homage with joined palms to him who dwells in the forest fastness.

sanskrit: rāmam evānugacchāmi sa rājā dvipadāṃ varaḥ trayāṇām api lokānāṃ rāghavo rājyam arhati
english: I shall follow Rāma himself. He is king, the foremost of bipeds. The Rāghava deserves the sovereignty of all three worlds.

sanskrit: tad vākyaṃ dharmasaṃyuktaṃ śrutvā sarve sabhāsadaḥ harṣān mumucur aśrūṇi rāme nihitacetasaḥ
english: Hearing those words full of dharma, all the members of the assembly, their hearts set on Rāma, shed tears of joy.

sanskrit: yadi tv āryaṃ na śakṣyāmi vinivartayituṃ vanāt vane tatraiva vatsyāmi yathāryo lakṣmaṇas tathā
english: But if I shall not be able to bring the noble one back from the forest, I shall dwell there in that very forest, just as the noble Lakṣmaṇa has done.

sanskrit: sarvopāyaṃ tu vartiṣye vinivartayituṃ balāt samakṣam ārya miśrāṇāṃ sādhūnāṃ guṇavartinām
english: I shall employ every means to forcibly bring him back, in the presence of the venerable ones, the virtuous, and those who walk the path of good qualities.

sanskrit: evam uktvā tu dharmātmā bharato bhrātṛvatsalaḥ samīpastham uvācedaṃ sumantraṃ mantrakovidam
english: Having spoken thus, the righteous-souled Bharata, devoted to his brothers, addressed Sumantra, the counselor skilled in deliberation, who stood nearby.

sanskrit: tūrṇam utthāya gaccha tvaṃ sumantra mama śāsanāt yātrām ājñāpaya kṣipraṃ balaṃ caiva samānaya
english: "Rise quickly and go, Sumantra, by my command. Order the march without delay and muster the army at once."

sanskrit: evam uktaḥ sumantras tu bharatena mahātmanā prahṛṣṭaḥ so 'diśat sarvaṃ yathā saṃdiṣṭam iṣṭavat
english: Thus instructed by the great-souled Bharata, Sumantra, filled with joy, ordered everything exactly as commanded, just as he had desired.

sanskrit: tāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ prakṛtayo balādhyakṣā balasya ca śrutvā yātrāṃ samājñaptāṃ rāghavasya nivartane
english: Those subjects and the commanders of the army were filled with joy upon hearing the march proclaimed for the bringing back of the Rāghava.

sanskrit: tato yodhāṅganāḥ sarvā bhartṝn sarvān gṛhegṛhe yātrā gamanam ājñāya tvarayanti sma harṣitāḥ
english: Then, learning of the departure, all the wives of warriors joyfully hastened their husbands in every household.

sanskrit: te hayair gorathaiḥ śīghraiḥ syandanaiś ca manojavaiḥ saha yodhair balādhyakṣā balaṃ sarvam acodayan
english: The commanders of the forces urged the entire army along with the warriors, using horses, swift ox-drawn carts, and chariots swift as thought.

sanskrit: sajjaṃ tu tad balaṃ dṛṣṭvā bharato gurusaṃnidhau rathaṃ me tvarayasveti sumantraṃ pārśvato 'bravīt
english: Seeing the army readied, Bharata, in the presence of his elders, said to Sumantra standing beside him: "Make my chariot ready at once."

sanskrit: bharatasya tu tasyājñāṃ pratigṛhya praharṣitaḥ rathaṃ gṛhītvā prayayau yuktaṃ paramavājibhiḥ
english: Receiving that command of Bharata's, Sumantra, filled with great joy, took up the chariot yoked with the finest horses and set it forward.

sanskrit: sa rāghavaḥ satyadhṛtiḥ pratāpavān bruvan suyuktaṃ dṛḍhasatyavikramaḥ guruṃ mahāraṇyagataṃ yaśasvinaṃ prasādayiṣyan bharato 'bravīt tadā
english: Then that Rāghava — firm in truth, resplendent, eloquent, mighty in truth and valor — spoke well, intending to appease his illustrious elder kinsman who had gone to the great forest.

sanskrit: tūrṇaṃ samutthāya sumantra gaccha balasya yogāya balapradhānān ānetum icchāmi hi taṃ vanasthaṃ prasādya rāmaṃ jagato hitāya
english: "Rise at once and go, Sumantra, to muster the army. I wish, for the good of the world, to appease Rāma who dwells in the forest and to bring back the foremost of the army."

sanskrit: sa sūtaputro bharatena samyag ājñāpitaḥ saṃparipūrṇakāmaḥ śaśāsa sarvān prakṛtipradhānān balasya mukhyāṃś ca suhṛjjanaṃ ca
english: That son of the charioteer, properly commanded by Bharata and with his desire fully fulfilled, directed all the chief citizens, the foremost commanders of the army, and the circle of friends.

sanskrit: tataḥ samutthāya kule kule te rājanyavaiśyā vṛṣalāś ca viprāḥ ayūyujann uṣṭrarathān kharāṃś ca nāgān hayāṃś caiva kulaprasūtān
english: Then, rising up, the kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, and brāhmaṇas in every household yoked their camel-drawn carts, donkeys, elephants, and horses of noble breed.

sanskrit: tataḥ samutthitaḥ kālyam āsthāya syandanottamam prayayau bharataḥ śīghraṃ rāmadarśanakāṅkṣayā
english: Then Bharata rose at dawn, mounted his finest chariot, and set out swiftly, longing to behold Rāma.

sanskrit: agrataḥ prayayus tasya sarve mantripurodhasaḥ adhiruhya hayair yuktān rathān sūryarathopamān
english: Before him proceeded all the ministers and the purohitas, having mounted chariots yoked with horses, resembling the chariot of the sun.

sanskrit: navanāgasahasrāṇi kalpitāni yathāvidhi anvayur bharataṃ yāntam ikṣvāku kulanandanam
english: Nine thousand fully caparisoned elephants followed Bharata as he journeyed — the delight of the Ikṣvāku lineage.

sanskrit: ṣaṣṭhī rathasahasrāṇi dhanvino vividhāyudhāḥ anvayur bharataṃ yāntaṃ rājaputraṃ yaśasvinam
english: Sixty thousand chariots bearing archers armed with various weapons followed the illustrious prince Bharata as he marched.

sanskrit: śataṃ sahasrāṇy aśvānāṃ samārūḍhāni rāghavam anvayur bharataṃ yāntaṃ rājaputraṃ yaśasvinam
english: A hundred thousand mounted horses followed the illustrious prince Bharata the Rāghava as he marched.

sanskrit: kaikeyī ca sumitrā ca kausalyā ca yaśasvinī rāmānayanasaṃhṛṣṭā yayur yānena bhāsvatā
english: Kaikeyī, Sumitrā, and the illustrious Kausalyā, rejoiced at the prospect of Rāma's return, traveled in their resplendent conveyances.

sanskrit: prayātāś cāryasaṃghātā rāmaṃ draṣṭuṃ salakṣmaṇam tasyaiva ca kathāś citrāḥ kurvāṇā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ
english: The gathered noble folk set forth to see Rāma together with Lakṣmaṇa, their minds delighted, telling wonderful tales about him.

sanskrit: meghaśyāmaṃ mahābāhuṃ sthirasattvaṃ dṛḍhavratam kadā drakṣyāmahe rāmaṃ jagataḥ śokanāśanam
english: "When shall we behold Rāma, dark as a raincloud, long-armed, steady in spirit, firm in his vow — he who destroys the grief of the world?"

sanskrit: dṛṣṭa eva hi naḥ śokam apaneṣyati rāghavaḥ tamaḥ sarvasya lokasya samudyann iva bhāskaraḥ
english: "For the Rāghava, once seen, will remove our grief, just as the rising sun dispels the darkness of the entire world."

sanskrit: ity evaṃ kathayantas te saṃprahṛṣṭāḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥ pariṣvajānāś cānyonyaṃ yayur nāgarikās tadā
english: Speaking thus, delighted, sharing these auspicious tales and embracing one another, the townspeople set out.

sanskrit: ye ca tatrāpare sarve saṃmatā ye ca naigamāḥ rāmaṃ prati yayur hṛṣṭāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayas tadā
english: All others who were respected there, and all the guild-members too, proceeded joyfully toward Rāma — all the subjects marched.

sanskrit: maṇi kārāś ca ye ke cit kumbhakārāś ca śobhanāḥ sūtrakarmakṛtaś caiva ye ca śastropajīvinaḥ
english: The gem-cutters and the fine potters, the weavers and those who live by arms —

sanskrit: māyūrakāḥ krākacikā rocakā vedhakās tathā dantakārāḥ sudhākārās tathā gandhopajīvinaḥ
english: The peacock-trainers, sawyers, dyers, piercers, ivory-carvers, plasterers, and those who live by selling fragrances —

sanskrit: suvarṇakārāḥ prakhyātās tathā kambaladhāvakāḥ snāpakācchādakā vaidyā dhūpakāḥ śauṇḍikās tathā
english: The renowned goldsmiths, blanket-washers, bath-attendants, clothiers, physicians, incense-sellers, and liquor dealers —

sanskrit: rajakās tunnavāyāś ca grāmaghoṣamahattarāḥ śailūṣāś ca saha strībhir yānti kaivartakās tathā
english: The washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and cowpens, actors along with their women, and fishermen likewise went.

sanskrit: samāhitā vedavido brāhmaṇā vṛttasaṃmatāḥ gorathair bharataṃ yāntam anujagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ
english: Composed, learned in the Vedas, brāhmaṇas esteemed for their conduct followed Bharata as he marched, in ox-drawn carts by the thousands.

sanskrit: suveṣāḥ śuddhavasanās tāmramṛṣṭānulepanāḥ sarve te vividhair yānaiḥ śanair bharatam anvayuḥ
english: Well-attired, clad in clean garments, anointed with red-tinged unguents, all of them followed Bharata at a measured pace in various conveyances.

sanskrit: prahṛṣṭamuditā senā sānvayāt kaikayīsutam vyavatiṣṭhata sā senā bharatasyānuyāyinī
english: That army, joyful and delighted, followed the son of Kaikeyī along with their kinsmen; the army that attended Bharata took up position.

sanskrit: nirīkṣyānugatāṃ senāṃ tāṃ ca gaṅgāṃ śivodakām bharataḥ sacivān sarvān abravīd vākyakovidaḥ
english: Surveying the army that followed and the Gaṅgā with its auspicious waters, Bharata, skilled in speech, addressed all his ministers.

sanskrit: niveśayata me sainyam abhiprāyeṇa sarvaśaḥ viśrāntaḥ pratariṣyāmaḥ śva idānīṃ mahānadīm
english: "Have my army encamp fully in accord with my intention. Having rested, we shall cross the great river tomorrow."

sanskrit: dātuṃ ca tāvad icchāmi svar gatasya mahīpateḥ aurdhvadeha nimittārtham avatīryodakaṃ nadīm
english: "And I wish to descend to the river to offer water for the sake of the post-mortem rites of the king who has gone to heaven."

sanskrit: tasyaivaṃ bruvato 'mātyās tathety uktvā samāhitāḥ nyaveśayaṃs tāṃś chandena svena svena pṛthakpṛthak
english: As he spoke thus, the ministers, saying "So be it," composed themselves and caused the various contingents to encamp, each according to its own will, separately.

sanskrit: niveśya gaṅgām anu tāṃ mahānadīṃ camūṃ vidhānaiḥ paribarha śobhinīm uvāsa rāmasya tadā mahātmano vicintayāno bharato nivartanam
english: Having encamped the splendidly equipped army along that great river, the Gaṅgā, in due order, Bharata lodged there, brooding at that time upon the return of the great-souled Rāma.

sanskrit: tato niviṣṭāṃ dhvajinīṃ gaṅgām anvāśritāṃ nadīm niṣādarājo dṛṣṭvaiva jñātīn saṃtvarito 'bravīt
english: Then the king of the Niṣādas, seeing the army encamped along the Gaṅgā river, hastily addressed his kinsmen.

sanskrit: mahatīyam ataḥ senā sāgarābhā pradṛśyate nāsyāntam avagacchāmi manasāpi vicintayan
english: "This great army visible here resembles the ocean; I cannot perceive its end, even when I reflect upon it in my mind."

sanskrit: sa eṣa hi mahākāyaḥ kovidāradhvajo rathe bandhayiṣyati vā dāśān atha vāsmān vadhiṣyati
english: "That large-bodied one there with the kovidāra banner on his chariot — he will either bind the fishermen or he will slay us."

sanskrit: atha dāśarathiṃ rāmaṃ pitrā rājyād vivāsitam bharataḥ kaikeyīputro hantuṃ samadhigacchati
english: "Or perhaps Bharata, son of Kaikeyī, advances to slay Rāma, son of Daśaratha, who was exiled from the kingdom by his father."

sanskrit: bhartā caiva sakhā caiva rāmo dāśarathir mama tasyārthakāmāḥ saṃnaddhā gaṅgānūpe 'tra tiṣṭhata
english: "Rāma, son of Daśaratha, is both my lord and my friend. Standing here on the bank of the Gaṅgā, stand armed and devoted to his cause."

sanskrit: tiṣṭhantu sarvadāśāś ca gaṅgām anvāśritā nadīm balayuktā nadīrakṣā māṃsamūlaphalāśanāḥ
english: "Let all the fishermen stand guard along the Gaṅgā river, armed in force, as guards of the river, subsisting on flesh, roots, and fruits."

sanskrit: nāvāṃ śatānāṃ pañcānāṃ kaivartānāṃ śataṃ śatam saṃnaddhānāṃ tathā yūnāṃ tiṣṭhantv atyabhyacodayat
english: He urgently ordered that a hundred men of each boat crew man each of the five hundred vessels, all armed and young men standing ready.

sanskrit: yadā tuṣṭas tu bharato rāmasyeha bhaviṣyati seyaṃ svastimayī senā gaṅgām adya tariṣyati
english: "When Bharata has been satisfied here regarding Rāma, then this army, bearing good omens, will cross the Gaṅgā today."

sanskrit: ity uktvopāyanaṃ gṛhya matsyamāṃsamadhūni ca abhicakrāma bharataṃ niṣādādhipatir guhaḥ
english: Having said this, the lord of the Niṣādas, Guha, took gifts of fish, meat, and honey and approached Bharata.

sanskrit: tam āyāntaṃ tu saṃprekṣya sūtaputraḥ pratāpavān bharatāyācacakṣe 'tha vinayajño vinītavat
english: Seeing him approaching, the resplendent son of the charioteer, Sumantra, knowing courtesy, announced him to Bharata in a respectful manner.

sanskrit: eṣa jñātisahasreṇa sthapatiḥ parivāritaḥ kuśalo daṇḍakāraṇye vṛddho bhrātuś ca te sakhā
english: "This headman, surrounded by a thousand kinsmen, is knowledgeable about the Daṇḍaka forest, is an elder, and is a friend of your brother."

sanskrit: tasmāt paśyatu kākutstha tvāṃ niṣādādhipo guhaḥ asaṃśayaṃ vijānīte yatra tau rāmalakṣmaṇau
english: "Therefore, O Kākutstha, let Guha the lord of the Niṣādas see you — without doubt he knows where Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa are."

sanskrit: etat tu vacanaṃ śrutvā sumantrād bharataḥ śubham uvāca vacanaṃ śīghraṃ guhaḥ paśyatu mām iti
english: Having heard this auspicious word from Sumantra, Bharata quickly said: "Let Guha come and see me."

sanskrit: labdhvābhyanujñāṃ saṃhṛṣṭo jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ āgamya bharataṃ prahvo guho vacanam abravīt
english: Having received permission, Guha, greatly delighted, surrounded by his kinsmen, came before Bharata and, bowing humbly, spoke these words.

sanskrit: niṣkuṭaś caiva deśo 'yaṃ vañcitāś cāpi te vayam nivedayāmas te sarve svake dāśakule vasa
english: "This is a district without a palace, and we ourselves are of humble estate. We offer everything we have to you; dwell among us in our fisherman clan."

sanskrit: asti mūlaṃ phalaṃ caiva niṣādaiḥ samupāhṛtam ārdraṃ ca māṃsaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca vanyaṃ coccāvacaṃ mahat
english: "There are roots and fruits gathered by the Niṣādas, fresh meat and dried meat, and great abundance of forest produce both coarse and fine."

sanskrit: āśaṃse svāśitā senā vatsyatīmāṃ vibhāvarīm arcito vividhaiḥ kāmaiḥ śvaḥ sasainyo gamiṣyasi
english: "I hope that your army, well-fed, will pass this night here; honored with various desired things, you will depart with your army tomorrow."
